main.en: Connect to the project, get an OpenAI client, call your deployment and keep the conversation.
main.ro: Project se juren, OpenAI client lein, apni deployment call karein aur guftagu rakhein.

explain.en: Two packages are enough: azure-ai-projects and azure-identity. AIProjectClient gets the project endpoint and a credential. DefaultAzureCredential tries several sources: environment, managed identity, az login. get_openai_client() returns an authenticated OpenAI client.
explain.ro: Do packages kaafi hain: azure-ai-projects aur azure-identity. AIProjectClient ko project endpoint aur credential milta hai. DefaultAzureCredential kai sources azmata hai: environment, managed identity, az login. get_openai_client() authenticated OpenAI client deta hai.

explain.en: The Responses API is the newer one: you send input and instructions and read output_text. For the next turn, pass previous_response_id or a conversation. Chat Completions takes a list of messages with roles and is stateless, so your code appends every answer with the assistant role.
explain.ro: Responses API naya hai: input aur instructions bhejein, output_text parhein. Agle turn ke liye previous_response_id ya conversation dein. Chat Completions roles wale messages ki list leta hai aur stateless hai, is liye code har jawab assistant role ke saath append karta hai.

explain.en: Real programs handle failures: 429 and temporary server errors with increasing waits, 400 with content_filter by a friendly message, 401/403/404 by fixing settings. Streaming shows the text while it is written.
explain.ro: Asal programs ghaltiyan sambhalte hain: 429 aur waqti server errors par barhta intezar, content_filter wale 400 par dostana paigham, 401/403/404 par settings theek karna. Streaming likhte waqt text dikhata hai.

title.en: One turn of a chat client

deep.en: Exponential backoff means waiting 1, 2, 4, 8 seconds after each 429, with a maximum number of tries. Retrying at once makes the overload worse. A content filter block is different: retrying the same prompt never helps, so show a message and let the user rephrase. Log the request ID and status, but never the key.
deep.ro: Exponential backoff ka matlab har 429 ke baad 1, 2, 4, 8 second rukna, koshishon ki had ke saath. Foran dobara koshish overload barhati hai. Content filter ki rok alag hai: wahi prompt dohrane se kabhi faida nahi, is liye paigham dikhayein aur user ko alfaaz badalne dein. Request ID aur status log karein, key kabhi nahi.

deep.en: Test the client in three situations: a normal question, a very long conversation and a wrong deployment name. If all three end with a clear message, the client is ready for users.
deep.ro: Client ko teen halaat mein test karein: aam sawal, bohat lambi guftagu aur ghalat deployment name. Teenon wazeh paigham par khatam hon to client users ke liye tayyar hai.

how.en: Put endpoint and deployment name in environment variables.
how.ro: Endpoint aur deployment ka naam environment variables mein rakhein.

how.en: Keep history short: last turns plus a summary of older ones.
how.ro: History mukhtasar: aakhri turns aur purane turns ka khulasa.

how.en: Read usage to see input and output tokens.
how.ro: usage parhein taake input aur output tokens pata hon.

text.en: A small chat loop with the Responses API:
text.ro: Responses API ke saath chhota chat loop:

example.code:
openai = AIProjectClient(
    endpoint=os.environ["PROJECT_ENDPOINT"],
    credential=DefaultAzureCredential()).get_openai_client()

last_id = None
while (text := input("You: ")):
    r = openai.responses.create(
        model="chat-prod", instructions="Be brief and friendly.",
        input=text, previous_response_id=last_id)
    last_id = r.id
    print("AI:", r.output_text)

right.en: It belongs to Chat Completions. Use output_text.
right.ro: Woh Chat Completions ka hai. output_text istemal karein.

wrong.en: "The key goes into the code for testing."

right.en: Use Entra ID from the start; keys in code end up in repositories.
right.ro: Shuru se Entra ID istemal karein; code ki keys repositories mein pohanch jati hain.

right.en: Only with previous_response_id, a conversation or the sent history.
right.ro: Sirf previous_response_id, conversation ya bheji hui history ke saath.

text.en: Project: …services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/name for AIProjectClient. OpenAI: …openai.azure.com/openai/v1 for the plain OpenAI client.
text.ro: Project: …services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/name, AIProjectClient ke liye. OpenAI: …openai.azure.com/openai/v1, saade OpenAI client ke liye.

text.en: With the first, the server keeps the history; with the second, your app does.
text.ro: Pehle mein history server rakhta hai; doosre mein aap ki app.

exam.en: Complete code: class, method, property. Know AIProjectClient, get_openai_client, responses.create, output_text.
exam.ro: Code mukammal karna: class, method, property. AIProjectClient, get_openai_client, responses.create, output_text yaad rakhein.

exam.en: Find the error: wrong endpoint, missing assistant message, wrong property, no retry.
exam.ro: Ghalti dhoondna: ghalat endpoint, assistant message nahi, ghalat property, retry nahi.
